GameConstantsAndTypes.h.contract: FailType ordinals 0..3: Immediate, ImmediateContinue, EndOfSong, Off

OptionsBinding.h.contract: ENUM_INTERFACE returns previous enum and supports optional chaining

PlayerOptions.cpp.contract: Approach copies FailType immediately; GetMods emits FailAtEnd; failendofsong is the ImmediateContinue alias
